terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The terms that apply when you use this store and buy digital products.
terms.body:
Who we are

This store sells digital products that you download after purchase.

Your account

You need an account with a confirmed email address to buy. Keep your password private; you are responsible for activity on your account.

Licence

Each purchase gives you a personal, non-transferable licence to download and use the product. You may not resell, share or publish the files unless the product page says otherwise.

Prices and payment

Prices are shown in US dollars and Saudi riyals. Payments are handled by our payment providers; we never see or store your card details.

Changes

We may update these terms. The version published on this page applies to new purchases.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal data we collect, why, and how long we keep it.
privacy.body:
What we collect

  • Your email address, to create your account, send confirmations and receipts.
  • Your orders: the products, amounts, the payment provider used and the payment reference.
  • Download records: when each file was downloaded, with a one-way hash of the IP address, never the address itself.

What we do not collect

We do not store card numbers or other payment details; the payment provider processes them.

How long we keep it

Your account and access to your products are kept until you delete your account. When you delete it, your account, sign-in details, access and download history are removed. Order records, including the email address used for each order, are kept for accounting and tax purposes for as long as the law requires.

Your rights

You can change your email or password, and delete your account, from your account page at any time.

refundPolicy.title: Refund policy
refundPolicy.description: When a digital purchase can be refunded.
refundPolicy.body:
Digital products

Because files are available for download right after payment, purchases are generally not refundable once a file has been downloaded, except where the law requires otherwise.

When we refund

  • The file is damaged or does not match its description, and we cannot fix it.
  • You were charged twice for the same order.
  • You have not downloaded the product and ask within 14 days of purchase.

How to ask

Contact us with your order number. Refunds go back to the original payment method, and access to the refunded products ends.
